text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You seem way more energetic than 
usual, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh... You slept well, huh? No wonder your 
complexion looks great and your skin is so 
radiant!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You look absolutely wonderful today! I'm 
so glad I got to meet you as you are right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, phone's ringing. Hello? Ah, it's 
you! I was just thinking I wanted to talk 
to you too! This must be fate!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, see you at the cafeteria later as 
planned, then! Catch ya later!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—Ah! Hey, hey, you over there! That's an 
amazing smile you've got! Would you mind 
letting me get a closer look?!”
